title: Silent Magician: Yugi's Silent Duo (lore build)
summary: Silent Magician is Yugi's level-up magician, and on its own it has no in-theme way to start. So this list pairs it with its twin from Yugi's deck, Silent Swordsman. The 2024 Zero versions of both come in too, with the Shining Sarcophagus Spells whose art shows them.

summary.title: Starters & Enablers
points: Silent Magician Zero and Silent Swordsman Zero, the newest (2024): they grow when the opponent draws or each Standby Phase, and negate while you control Shining Sarcophagus.
Silent Magician and Silent Swordsman (2016), which float into their LV8 and LV7 forms when destroyed, plus the original LV lines.
Silent Paladin, the Fairy that searches both LV starters.
Shining Sarcophagus and the Spells drawn with the Silent duo: Ties That Bind shows the Zeros, Future Silence the old Magician and Turn Silence the old Swordsman.

summary.title: Opening: Shining Sarcophagus & The Zeros
steps: Activate Shining Sarcophagus and use its ignition effect to add Ties That Bind to your hand.
Activate Ties That Bind to Special Summon Silent Magician Zero and Silent Swordsman Zero directly from your Deck.
Alternatively, Normal Summon Silent Magician Zero, then tribute it to Special Summon Silent Magician from your hand.
Set Turn Silence or keep Silent Burning in hand to disrupt the opponent and protect your growing spellcasters.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Silent Magician gains 500 ATK for each card in your hand, negates a Spell Card activation once per turn as a Quick Effect, and when destroyed by battle or opponent effect, floats directly into Silent Magician LV8 ignoring summoning conditions.
Silent Magician LV8 possesses 3500 ATK and is completely unaffected by your opponent's Spell effects.
Silent Swordsman gains 500 ATK during each Standby Phase, negates a Spell Card activation once per turn, and floats into Silent Swordsman LV7 upon destruction.
Silent Swordsman LV7 completely negates the effects of all Spell Cards on the field, shutting down entire opposing engines.
Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden allows small Spellcasters to easily send themselves to the GY to trigger floating effects.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Silent Burning refills both players' hands to 6 cards during the Battle Phase while you control a Silent Magician monster, and banishes itself from the GY to search any Silent Magician monster.
Silent Sword Slash makes a Silent Swordsman monster gain 1500 ATK/DEF and completely unaffected by opponent card effects, and banishes from the GY to search a Silent Swordsman.
Future Silence searches a monster mentioning Shining Sarcophagus and provides battle-phase card draw.
Turn Silence increases a monster's Level by 3 and negates an opponent's monster effect while you control Shining Sarcophagus.
Level Up! sends an LV monster to the GY to Special Summon the higher-level form directly from your hand or Deck ignoring summoning conditions.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Silent Magician, the Silent Fighter is not yet released in the TCG and is excluded from the lineup.
